name: 阿尔伯特·沙茨
bio_short: 美国微生物学家，链霉素的共同发现者。作为瓦克斯曼的博士生，他在实验室中亲手分离出了链霉素（`waksman_streptomycin_1943`）。尽管他为此赢得了法律诉讼并获得“共同发现者”的头衔，但他遗憾地未能分享当年的诺贝尔奖。
bio_short_en: An American microbiologist and co-discoverer of streptomycin. As Waksman's PhD student, he personally isolated streptomycin in the lab (`waksman_streptomycin_1943`). Although he successfully sued for legal recognition as a 'co-discoverer', he was controversially excluded from the Nobel Prize.
